gold_doubt: The gold omits AMS-Osram's specific work on optical links between GPUs and high-bandwidth memory, which appears relevant to NVIDIA's interconnect business under 5.1.

The gold excludes AMS-Osram's agreement partly because the partner is unnamed and the size and date are missing. Sections 5.1 and 5.2 say those omissions alone do not exclude a named company's action; whether its competitive relevance is sufficient still needs judgment.

The gold excludes the dated Microsoft–MediaTek interconnect plan because it states no NVIDIA link. Since the article identifies NVIDIA's interconnect business, the plan's potential competitive relevance under 5.1 deserves review.
